name: Sato
source:
[url=/c166736]Kim[/url]'s alternate persona, though that doesn't capture what she really is. She speaks Japanese naturally and moves with confidence Kim never shows. She's from a parallel reality where details are different: [url=/c166738]Liv[/url] has blonde hair, the captain is named Valerie instead of [url=/c166741]Veronica[/url]. She's not a split personality. She's something crossing between realities.
